violations.description: NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - DESIGN (1 pts): Countertop material noted not in good repair near and underneith espresso machine. Surface material is delaminating from wood base layer.

TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Under counter refrigerator below espresso machine noted with thermometer not in a conspicuous location. 2 door upright refrigerator in rear storage area noted with no thermometer. Digital thermometer not displaying temperature.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted laying on counter in food prep area.

inspections.comments: Suggest using a mixture of quat sanitizer from 3 compartment sink dispenser for wiping food prep area surfaces.

violations.description: DISHWASHING FACILITIES (2 pts): Sanitizer test kit noted not provided for the towel bucket sanitizer.
TOILET FACILITIES (1 pts): Toilet room door noted not self closing.
